article.headline: Oklahoma upsets No. 1 Texas on Tate Sandell's game-ending 47-yard field goal
article.description: — Oklahoma and coach Brent Venables really needed this win. Getting it against top-ranked Texas in their Red River rivalry game and donning the Golden Hat trophy just made it that much better.
